## Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ⚡ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 🚀 Performance optimization
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] 🧪 Tests / Benchmarks

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the code style of this project (`zig fmt`).
- [ ] I have added unit tests covering the new behavior / edge cases (`zig build test`).
- [ ] I have run the benchmarks and confirmed no regressions (`zig build bench`).
- [ ] If changing public APIs, I have updated the `README.md` and `build.zig.zon` version if appropriate.
- [ ] Commit message follows Conventional Commits format (e.g. `feat(cbor): ...`, `fix(json): ...`).
